# atlas-budget-model

Budget model for **Project Atlas** phase one. Owner: **Maria Lopez** (finance).

Planned spend is 825,000 EUR: hub lease 240,000, vehicles and equipment 310,000, hiring and training 180,000, and marketing 95,000. A 10 percent contingency is being added at the request of **Joe Smith**. Break-even is forecast for month 14 after the Lisbon launch.

All figures are fictional test data.
